title: M2Polymath: pi(x) mod 3, divisor sums and the exact degree (Lean 4 formalization and checks)
description:
Lean 4 formalization, exact-arithmetic check code and review reports for an obstruction theorem and an exact degree formula for prime-counting congruences from divisor sums, linked to the Polymath4 project. For identities built from shifted and twisted zeta and Dirichlet L factors with squarefull corrections: no identity detects primes modulo p; the divided count needs a factor whose degree is divisible by p exactly once; the least degree yielding pi(x) mod p^k is S(p^ceil(k/2)) (signed) or S(p^k) (unsigned), with S the Kempner function. pi(x) mod 3 below the square root is equivalent to D_3(x) mod 9 below the square root, and D_3(x) is computable in O(x^(5/9) log^2 x) operations, so pi(x) mod 3 is computable in x^(5/9+o(1)) (the algorithm's correctness is formalized, and since version 1.2.0 so is the per-call cost of its incomplete hyperbola sums in an explicit operation-count model; the assembly into x^(5/9) is a paper proof). Includes 2,353 Lean declarations (version 1.2.0, Lean v4.35.0-rc2) on the standard axioms only and a Lean function computing pi(x) mod 3, proved correct for every x.

AI assistance: this work was prepared with Claude (Anthropic), an AI model, which helped draft the text, develop and check the proofs, run the computations, and search the literature. Several results, marked A19 in CLAIMS.md, were first proposed by ChatGPT (OpenAI) and independently checked here. The formalized statements are machine-checked in Lean 4; the rest is not. The author, Joseph S. Farland, chose the problems, directed the work, and is responsible for its content. No external human referee has reviewed this work.
notes: Version 1.1.0: ported to Lean and Mathlib v4.35.0-rc2 and Lean's module system with no change to any theorem statement; adds the Palomar layout (Challenge.lean, Solution.lean, comparator.json, formalization.yaml). Build: lake exe cache get && lake build. Companion preprint: 10.5281/zenodo.24408923.
